children: Overview
China traditional medicine maker's half-year total revenue fell 27% yr/yr
Company posted RMB 776.3 mln net loss attributable for the period
Sales declined across all major business segments, especially concentrated granules and herb integration
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook commentary in the press release
Result Drivers

SEGMENT SALES DECLINES - Sales fell across all major business segments,  mainly due to the decline in terminal demand and the decrease in sales volume, especially concentrated granules and herb integration
CONCENTRATED GRANULES PRESSURE – Revenue fell 35.4% to RMB1.93 bln as policy adjustments and market changes weakened terminal demand and sales volumes
HERBS BUSINESS DOWNSIZING – Chinese medicinal-herbs integration revenue fell 57.5% to RMB190 mln as the group cut high-risk activities and market prices declined
